brief: Write a 55–85-word English recommendation for a fictional archive choosing between Cedar and Elm. The mandatory first-year budget is at most 2,400 currency units including installation. Use only S1, cite it and state the decisive comparison. Assume the listed nonprice requirements are equally met.

sources.text: Fictional binding quotes: Cedar costs 2,100 for the first year plus a mandatory 500 installation fee. Elm costs 2,300 for the first year with installation included and no other first-year charges. Both meet the same throughput, storage and support requirements. The first-year budget is a hard limit of 2,400, with no exception approved.

rubric.instructions: Judge first submissions against the same brief and full supplied sources. Do not award points for files, logs, checklist markers or report length. Rate each dimension separately with a reason, an exact locatable excerpt and source evidence. Do not compute a weighted passing score. Prefer the report that better supports the requested decision; use tie for comparable quality and unresolved for missing evidence. Give condition clues only after choosing. Model preferences and ratings need evidence review before any efficacy interpretation.
